name: agy-autonomous-mcp-modeling-plugin
description: High-completion autonomous 3D CAD, architectural, and hard-surface modeling in Blender from multi-view blueprints and reference photos via MCP. Features pixel-ruler calibration, high-density detail tiling, dual coordinate conventions, true structural section profiles (HEB/IPE/louvers/slats/railings), feature ledger audit, and 5-camera + closeup visual verification.
suggestedPrompts: 根据输入的三视图与参考照片，按 L1/L2/L3 三级细部拆解在Blender中完成高精度三维建模并输出多视图与节点特写对比图
为当前平面图/剖面图生成半透明像素坐标标定网格，并为实景照片生成高梯度细部放大切片，解算比例尺后分层建模
渲染当前Blender场景的5机位总览图、1:1边缘轮廓叠合图与关键节点特写，运行拓扑与细部台账审计并闭环微调
